messages:
anya (eng): Postmortem posted — root cause: short-lived cloud auth token rotation + model-registry retry storm caused auth provider throttling -> fallback path hit external auth endpoints and exhausted a vendor rate quota, led to 9m degradation for hosted inference. Link: https://redwood.in/postmortems/1938456721
max (sre): Confirming. We saw 429 spikes from vendor auth at 15:12 UTC, followed by queued KV cache misses that amplified downstream calls.
leo (vendor-relations): I've opened an escalation with the vendor, ticket #VR-4782. They're investigating token refresh behavior on their side but asked for our request pattern. I can share traces.
maria (security): Action: rotate the service account token TTL settings and add short-term creds audit. Owner: maria. ETA: 2026-04-02.
prakash (product): We need a public-facing status blurb if dry-run failover is scheduled. Also want a customer-impact review for enterprise tenants. Owner: prakash. ETA: 2026-03-30.
max (sre): Action: add a circuit-breaker on model-registry auth calls and exponential backoff to avoid fanout. Owner: max. ETA: 2026-03-27. Test: automated canary that simulates auth 429s.
anya (eng): Action: add prefix-KV caching fallbacks to reduce registry roundtrips (short term) + add telemetry for auth failure rates in route-level dashboards. Owner: anya. ETA: 2026-03-29.
slo-bot: Incident summary: duration 9m, error budget hit 0.03% for hosted-api route, peak error rate 78% for auth calls at 15:14 UTC.
leo (vendor-relations): Vendor asked for request samples. @anya can you attach a 1-min captured trace and curl sample?
anya (eng): attaching snippet in thread: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://model-reg.redwood.internal/v1/metadata || echo "auth fail"``` will send.
maria (security): Also add KMS/HSM usage verification in the playbook. If token rotation required, patch the runbook with exact KMS steps.
max (sre): I'll file the runbook PR after tests. Link to TODO: https://git.redwood/sre/runbooks/model-reg-auth.md
prakash (product): Can we schedule a vendor dry-run: vendor failover + our fallback for a 30m window, to validate the circuit-breaker and canary? Owner: leo. Target date: 2026-04-08 (tentative).
leo (vendor-relations): I'll coordinate dates with vendor and legal for test authorization. Will confirm by 2026-03-31.
anya (eng): Ownership matrix for follow-ups (quick): max -> circuit-breaker + runbook PR; anya -> caching + telemetry; maria -> token/KMS audit + rotation; leo -> vendor coordination + SLA review; prakash -> customer comms + impact review.
max (sre): Also propose adding automated alert that trips when auth 5xx/429 > 5% sustained for 2 mins, with paging to oncall. Owner: max. ETA: 2026-03-25.
maria (security): Request: include rotation in quarterly secret drills and confirm HSM logging for all rotations.
prakash (product): Suggestion: add this incident class to recurring incident pattern review — label: external-auth-throttle. We'll track recurrence and mitigation coverage in the risk register. Owner: prakash.
anya (eng): I'll add a short eval harness to simulate the retry fanout in CI so we don't regress. ETA: 2026-03-28.
max (sre): Can ops run a dry-run failover checklist w/ steps: 1) throttle sim 2) enable circuit-breaker 3) verify cache hits 4) monitor errors. I'll draft and ping for review.
leo (vendor-relations): Vendor wants the specific SLA clause cited. @maria can legal/security pull contract excerpt?
maria (security): On it. Will attach clause and risk commentary by 2026-03-26.
prakash (product): We'll do a 30-min sync next Tue to confirm timelines. Please bring runbook PR links and vendor date.
anya (eng): ack. I'll update the postmortem doc with owners and a short checklist.
max (sre): thumbs up. :thumbsup:
leo (vendor-relations): thanks all — I'll follow up when vendor confirms test window.
anya (eng): closing note: aim to reduce single-vendor auth blast radius; long-term: support dual auth paths + vendor-side rate-limiting work. Added to roadmap backlog.
max (sre): +1. Marking as "action items assigned" in tracker.
prakash (product): added to weekly risk review agenda.
maria (security): acknowledged.
anya (eng): End of thread.
